_doc: Hand-entered seed batch from the Vivre Card ~ One Piece Visual Dictionary ~ booster sets (initial 2018 release + Volume X expansions). Tier defaults to 'likely' per canon-sources.md — extended-media height/profile data has historically been revised between editions, so it stays sub-canon unless an SBS or manga panel corroborates. Edition string follows the pattern 'visual_dictionary_<year>' for Vivre Card facts. Expand this file or add data_manual/vivre_card_<set>.json siblings.
